V1BZ shipped the first Topology → Diagnose handoff (typed payload contract + CTA + receiving stub) and V1CA polished the receiving panel to match Anthracite visual law. Between V1AY and V1CA the rig acquired: durable environment persistence (V1BO), topology env selector (V1BP), persisted node positions (V1BQ), archive/restore (V1BR), icon-as-frame glyphs (V1BR-HF/V1BS), fabricator quality (V1BT), device state layer (V1BU), link state layer (V1BV), legend + affected-only (V1BW), affected path incident focus (V1BX), topology source contract (V1BY + HF1/HF2 header consolidation), Diagnose handoff (V1BZ → V1CA). Hardware inspection theatre (V1BD-V1BI) and the blueprint topology canvas (V1BF-V1BN) landed mid-arc. Fabricator Foundation (D4A) seeded the lab engine that the topology source contract now reads.

endgame.one_line: Anthracite is the read-only network truth workstation that turns live access and imported evidence into topology, diagnosis, and safe-change preparation.
endgame.customer_sentence: Anthracite gives network engineers a trusted operating desk that turns read-only network evidence into live topology, affected-path understanding, diagnosis, and safe-change preparation.
endgame.investor_sentence: Anthracite is the trust layer between network reality and network automation.
expensive_questions: What is broken, risky, stale, or unknown?
What should I safely investigate or change next?
endgame.product_loop: Read-only access → evidence receipts → inventory truth → topology truth → affected-path understanding → Diagnose explanation → Assessment → Safe action preparation

lanes.title: Lane 1 — Truth Acquisition
lanes.goal: Anthracite can collect or ingest facts without manual config hand-curation.

lanes.title: Lane 2 — Truth Model
lanes.goal: Anthracite can explain why it believes a device, link, state, or risk exists.

lanes.title: Lane 3 — Operator Workflow

campaigns.title: Week 1 — First Real Evidence Loop
campaigns.goal: Imported or read-only collected facts can enter the same topology/source pipeline as generated labs.

items.title: V1CB — Imported Evidence → Topology Adapter
items.why: Proves Anthracite is not only a generated-lab toy.
items.acceptance: Imported evidence renders on the same Topology canvas path as Fabricator. Topology shows source as Imported. Affected focus and Diagnose handoff still work.

items.title: V1CC — Read-Only Collection Target Model
items.why: Enterprise customers give constrained access, not zip files of configs.
items.acceptance: Operator can define a read-only discovery target model without running live collection yet. Credential reference, not plaintext.

items.title: V1CD — Collection Receipt Model
items.why: Enterprise trust comes from evidence, not magic.
items.acceptance: Imported topology and future live collection can both attach receipts (what / source / when / method / accepted / rejected / confidence / freshness).

items.title: V1CE — Live Collector Dry-Run Shell
items.why: Bridge from model to field execution. No real risky device contact yet.
items.acceptance: Anthracite can say: 'If run, I would contact these devices with these read-only methods and produce these receipt types.' No polling daemon, no scheduler, no background loop.
